info.title: AgilFrame API
info.description:
AgilFrame — встраиваемая платформа видеозвонков: комнаты и WebRTC-сигналинг,
чат и файлы, запись и субтитры, темы, права и аудит, AI-ассистенты, вебхуки.

**С чего начать:** человекочитаемое руководство — `/docs/api-guide.md`,
подробный справочник — `/docs/api.md`, контракт — `/docs/contract.md`.
Интерактивный офлайн-эксплорер — `/docs` (без CDN).

**Авторизация:** `x-api-key` — админский ключ тенанта, только с сервера
(никогда не отдавайте его в браузер); `authorization: Bearer <join token>` —
короткоживущий токен участника для звонка, чата, файлов, STT и ассистента.
`GET /openapi.json` — только публичная спека, `/openapi.admin.json` — полная
(доступ управляется `AGIL_DOCS_*` / `AGIL_ADMIN_*`).

**Ошибки:** всегда `{error:{code,message}}`; коды — `unauthorized`, `forbidden`,
`validation_failed`, `password_required`, `password_invalid`, `geo_blocked`,
`room_locked`, `room_full`, `rate_limited`, `not_found`, `feature_disabled`,
`provider_failed`, `stt_not_configured`, `internal_error`.

WebSocket-сигналинг — `/ws?token=<join token>` (см. docs/api.md §10).

x-websocket.auth: token query param or anonymous room/tenant/name when AGIL_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS=1

post.summary: Проверить корпоративную OIDC-идентичность (SSO; без выдачи токенов)
post.description:
Проверяет подпись OIDC-JWT (RS256/ES256) по JWKS тенанта, issuer/audience/exp/nbf и маппинг claims — без выдачи join-токена. Токен не логируется и не пишется в аудит.

Verifies RS256/ES256 signature against the tenant `integrations.identity.jwksUrl`, checks issuer/audience/exp/nbf and maps claims. Used by SSO joins; the token itself is never logged or audited.

get.summary: Начать вход в панель через SSO: state+nonce+PKCE → authorization URL IdP
get.description: Requires `integrations.identity.mode:"oidc"` with issuer/clientId and either explicit endpoints or `discovery:true` (issuer `/.well-known/openid-configuration`, or an explicit `discoveryUrl`); explicit endpoint fields always win over discovered values and serve as fallback when discovery fails. Creates a single-use state (TTL 10 min, in memory), a nonce and an S256 PKCE challenge and returns the authorization URL. For same-origin browser starts it also sets an HttpOnly state-binding cookie (AGIL_OIDC_COOKIE_BINDING, default on) that the callback must present (login-CSRF defense); with `responseMode:"form_post"` the cookie is SameSite=None (Secure in production) for the cross-site POST. No token or secret is returned or logged.

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: Same-origin relative path or an absolute URL from AGIL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN / integrations.allowedOrigins (default /dashboard/); backslashes/control characters are rejected

get.summary: OIDC redirect URI (response_mode=query): code exchange + id_token verification → admin session
get.description: Consumes the single-use state (and the browser-binding cookie when set), exchanges `code` at the token endpoint (`client_secret_post` by default, or `client_secret_basic`; the secret comes from the allowlisted, tenant-bound server env var named by `clientSecretEnv`: AGIL_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_<TENANT>_<NAME> or an AGIL_OIDC_TENANT_SECRETS entry), verifies the id_token against the tenant JWKS (signature, iss, aud/azp, exp/nbf/iat, nonce, optional tenant claim, email allowlist and dashboard admin groups) and redirects (302) to `returnTo#sso_token=<admin session JWT>`. Failures redirect to `returnTo#sso_error=<code>` (`state_invalid`, `state_expired`, `idp_error`, `access_denied`, `invalid_identity_token`, `identity_not_verified`, `identity_not_allowed`, `tenant_mismatch`, `identity_not_configured`, `validation_failed`). Tokens, codes and secrets are never logged.

302.description: Redirect with the admin session in the URL fragment, or `#sso_error=<code>`

post.summary: OIDC redirect URI (response_mode=form_post): same flow, parameters in the form body
post.description: OAuth 2.0 Form Post Response Mode: the IdP POSTs `code`/`state`/`error` as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (64 KiB bound) to this redirect URI. The state, nonce, PKCE, id_token and binding-cookie checks are identical to the GET callback; every outcome is a redirect, never a JSON body. Requires `integrations.identity.responseMode:"form_post"` and a SameSite=None binding cookie (HTTPS production deployments). A wrong Content-Type or an oversized body answers 302 `#sso_error=validation_failed` before the state is consumed.

302.description: Redirect with the admin session in the URL fragment, or `#sso_error=<code>`

get.summary: RP-initiated logout: IdP end_session URL (client_id + post_logout_redirect_uri + state)
get.description: Opt-in corporate logout. When `integrations.identity.endSessionEndpoint` is configured (explicitly or via discovery) returns a 200 with the IdP `end_session_endpoint` URL carrying `client_id`, the registered `post_logout_redirect_uri` (default `<AGIL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN>/v1/auth/oidc/logout/callback`) and a single-use `state` (10 min, in memory). The dashboard navigates there after revoking the local AGIL session. `id_token_hint` is not sent (this server never retains the IdP id_token). 501 `identity_not_configured` means RP logout is unavailable; clients keep the local-only logout.

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: Dashboard target after the IdP redirects back (validated like the login returnTo)

200.description: IdP RP-initiated logout URL + state expiry

post.summary: Revoke the current dashboard SSO session (local logout)
post.description: Revokes the signed admin session `jti` in the in-process deny-list until its `exp` and returns 204. Bearer-only (no cookie auth, so no CSRF token is required); an unknown/expired token also returns 204 (idempotent, no token oracle). Revocation is per-process: multi-node deployments need sticky sessions or a shared store. This endpoint does not terminate the IdP session; use GET /v1/auth/oidc/logout for RP-initiated logout when configured.

get.summary: Default post_logout_redirect_uri: validates the logout state and returns to the dashboard
get.description: Consumes the single-use logout `state` issued by GET /v1/auth/oidc/logout and redirects (302) to the dashboard target stored with it (no token or IdP data in the URL). An unknown/expired state redirects to the default dashboard: the local logout has already happened, so this is not an error for the user.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Single-use logout state returned by the IdP

get.summary: Проверка живости и флаги безопасности
Readiness for API and signaling traffic
Resolve the request Host to a tenant + branding (custom domains; fallback to default tenant)
Proxy-only on-demand TLS approval hook (Caddy/HAProxy): 200 only for a verified custom domain
get.description: Proxy-only and secret-gated: `AGIL_DOMAIN_ASK_SECRET` is mandatory (empty = 403), the `Host` must be in `AGIL_DOMAIN_ASK_HOSTS` (default loopback/localhost; this distinguishes Caddy’s internal ask from an external request forwarded by Caddy on the same TCP peer), failed secrets use a per-client limiter, and only authenticated approvals are checked against the TCP-peer allowlist `AGIL_DOMAIN_ASK_ALLOW_IPS` and its per-peer rate limit. Deployments must additionally block /v1/domain/ask in the public site block. The response intentionally omits `tenantId`.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Shared secret (required: AGIL_DOMAIN_ASK_SECRET; empty secret disables the hook)

post.summary: Start an outbound SIP/PSTN call into the room (host/moderator or admin key; not anonymous)
post.description: Requires `features.sipDialIn` and `scale.sip.enabled`; `501` when the gateway is disabled/unconfigured, `409 e2ee_incompatible` when E2EE is active, `429` rate limit, `409 sip_limit_reached` at `scale.sip.maxConcurrent`, `502 sip_failed` on a gateway failure, `503 sip_node_unavailable` when the bound module is unavailable. The number is E.164 only and is never returned or audited unmasked.

502.description: SIP gateway failure (`sip_failed`); upstream detail is redacted (no URLs/tokens/phone numbers)

Digits-only/phone-like ids are rejected with `400 validation_failed` so they never reach audit/logs.

post.summary: Войти в комнату: пароль, lock, лимит, гео, rate-limit; возвращает join-токен
post.description: Вызывается браузером/сервером компании. Проверяет пароль, lock, гео-политику, лимит участников и rate-limit; возвращает токен и эффективные права для UI.

post.summary: Отправить сообщение в чат звонка (внешний чат; идемпотентно по id)
post.description:
Вызывается сервером компании (внешний чат/бот) с join-токеном. Сообщение бродкастится в звонок, пишется в историю, уходит вебхуком chat.message; повтор с тем же `id` не дублирует.

Requires the effective `chat` permission. Text messages need `session.chat.allowHostInjection`; system notices need `session.chat.allowSystemMessages` and a host/moderator role.

post.summary: AI-ассистент в звонке с правами участника
post.description:
Вызывается браузером с join-токеном. Ассистент отвечает от имени пользователя: сервер фильтрует предложенные действия по эффективным правам; `mode:local` — 501, движок в виджете.

Requires `session.inCallAgent.enabled`. `mode:"local"` answers 501 assistant_local_only (the widget runs the offline assistant). `hybrid` falls back to 501 on endpoint failure; `external` is fail-closed (502 provider_failed). Actions are filtered through the effective permissions and `maxActionsPerReply`.

post.summary: Загрузить файл в чат (raw body, лимит из конфига)
post.description:
Вызывается браузером с join-токеном. Требует features.fileShare и права fileShare; возвращает запись с подписанной ссылкой.

Malware scanning is opt-in per tenant (`security.avScan.enabled`) and needs a deployment engine (`AGIL_CLAMAV_*` / `AGIL_YARA_RULES`). `mode:'sync'` can reject the upload; `async` answers first and quarantines the stored copy afterwards (see docs/liveness-av.md).

503.description: `scan_unavailable` — scanner error/timeout under fail-closed (sync mode, quarantined)

get.summary: Скачать файл по подписанной ссылке

post.summary: Выдать серверный liveness-челлендж (advisory; 501 без движка)
post.description: Requires `security.liveness.enabled` and an engine (`AGIL_LIVENESS_ENGINE=challenge` by default, or a self-hosted `AGIL_LIVENESS_URL`). Returns a random task (`blink` | `head-left` | `head-right`) bound to the token tenant+room+participant with a TTL. The verdict is advisory and NOT a certified deepfake detection; see docs/liveness-av.md.

post.summary: Проверить liveness-попытку по сигналам браузера (advisory)
post.description: The browser reports only signals (`faceDetected`, `blinkDetected`, `headTurnDetected`, `modelAvailable`, `confidence`) — video never leaves the device. Sessions are tenant-scoped, single-use after a pass, TTL-bounded and attempt-bounded. Engine errors follow `security.liveness.onEngineError` (`fail-open` default).

post.summary: Серверный speech-to-text: локальный whisper.cpp/faster-whisper или внешний провайдер (501, если не настроен)
post.description: Chunked captions (~8 s webm/opus from the widget). `STT_PROVIDER=local` runs on-box and attaches machine translations when the tenant sets `session.transcription.translateTo` **and** `features.translation=true`; `x-translate-to` cannot bypass the feature flag. A translation failure never discards the transcript; it is reported in `notice`.

parameters.name: x-chunk-offset
parameters.description: Non-negative seconds since call start; added to every segment timestamp (invalid = 400 invalid_chunk_offset)

200.description: Transcript segments with optional machine translation

Перевести одну строку локальным/LLM-движком тенанта (браузерный STT, повторный перевод)
Standby Core joins with a one-time core enrollment token
post.description: Token-only machine endpoint (no admin key). Token kind must be `core`; the tenant comes from the token, never from headers. The standby is listed in `GET /v1/admin/cluster/status`. With `AGIL_REDIS_URL` set, leadership is a Redis lease: a standby acquires it after the leader dies (no room-state replication — see docs/ha-leader.md). Optional IP fence: `AGIL_ENROLL_ALLOW_IPS`. A non-leader Core rejects this with 409 `not_leader`.

503.description: Cluster registry write failed (`registry_unavailable`); retry the request

post.summary: Node enrolls with a one-time node token and receives its per-node key once
post.description: Token-only machine endpoint. Role/features are scoped by the token (features must be a subset). `nodeKey` is returned exactly once and stored hashed. Optional `keyTtlSec` sets its lifetime (default `AGIL_NODE_KEY_TTL_SEC`, 0 = no expiry); rotate via `POST /v1/admin/nodes/{nodeId}/rotate-key`. Optional IP fence: `AGIL_ENROLL_ALLOW_IPS`. Standby Core: 409 `not_leader`.

503.description: Cluster registry write failed (`registry_unavailable`); retry the request

post.summary: Node liveness/capacity heartbeat (x-node-token)
post.description: Authenticated by the per-node key (header `x-node-token` or `Authorization: Bearer`), bound to this node id. Two rate limiters protect the endpoint: an outer bucket charged **before** credential validation (per client IP, `AGIL_HEARTBEAT_IP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN`, default 600/min — a 61-node fleet behind one NAT needs ~122/min) and a per-node bucket charged only after the credential authenticates (`AGIL_HEARTBEAT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN`, default 10/min; keyed by tenant id + node id, so the same node id in two tenants gets independent buckets). Invalid or missing keys therefore cannot mint per-node buckets. Expired keys return 401 (rotate them). Optional `metrics` carries live node statistics (CPU/memory %, load1, active rooms/participants, bandwidth, uptime, agent version, `reportedAt`). Every metric field is optional and values are range-validated; a report is merged into the previous snapshot, and the server never invents or zero-fills a metric. `node.metrics` is absent until the node sends its first report. Old agents that send only `capacity`/`status` stay compatible. Optional `modules` is the full module inventory snapshot: omitted keeps the previous one, `[]` honestly means "none installed". Reserved catalog ids require their allowlisted image repository. Other valid ids appear in inventory, with optional locally approved lifecycle control. Optional `moduleResults` acknowledges commands received on an earlier heartbeat (`{commandId, ok, status, error?}`); unknown/expired command ids are ignored. The response always carries `moduleCommands`: commands to execute now, each delivered exactly once (TTL 5 min; a graceful `status: "offline"` beat receives none).

parameters.name: x-node-token
parameters.description: Per-node key (`nk_…`) returned once at registration

503.description: Cluster registry write failed (`registry_unavailable`); retry the request

post.summary: Redeem an Edge enrollment token → room + join token + secret-free destinations
post.description: Machine surface: the enrollment token (`agil_edge_…`) is the only credential and scopes the tenant. The Edge publishes media once into `roomId`; the server starts RTMP/HLS/recording egress from that room. An unavailable egress worker is reported as `egress_unavailable` and never blocks the join. Rate-limited per IP; optional `AGIL_ENROLL_ALLOW_IPS` applies.

get.summary: Эта OpenAPI 3.1 спека (только публичные пути)
Офлайн API-эксплорер (self-contained HTML)

bearer.description: Join token from /v1/rooms/:id/join or an invite; or an SSO admin session from GET /v1/auth/oidc/callback (tenant admin endpoints only)

baseEtag.description: Version returned when the editor loaded the tenant config

roleName.description: Display name of a custom role

maxParticipants.description: Requested capacity. Core applies plan and media limits. Direct rooms have at most two seats.

mode.description: direct = 1:1 messenger call (max 2 participants); group = default

transport.description: Direct (mode:"direct") only. p2p = browser-to-browser mesh, exactly 2 seats, no server media (docs/p2p.md); sfu/omitted = current effective media plane. 400 for group mode or >2 seats; 409 p2p_unsupported when server egress/streaming/webinar is enabled.

allowedParticipantIds.description: List of company user IDs. Requires an API key at creation and a signed participant token to join.

rtmpUrl.description: RTMP/RTMPS ingest URL (required for kind=rtmp; redacted in logs/audit)

startNodeAvailable.description: Whether the tenant has no managed Egress binding or its bound module is ready for new jobs

url.description: Absolute same-origin capability URL (HMAC + exp); no S3 credentials

ttlSec.description: Link lifetime in seconds (default AGIL_EGRESS_PLAYBACK_TTL_SEC; hard cap 24 h)

apply.description: true stops the listed jobs; false (default) is a dry run

thresholdSec.description: Jobs active longer than this are considered stuck (default AGIL_EGRESS_STUCK_AFTER_SEC)

startedAt.description: Epoch ms; null when egress did not report it

startNodeAvailable.description: Whether the tenant has no managed Egress binding or its bound module is ready for new jobs

reachable.description: null when no health URL is configured

detail.description: Failure reason; never contains the URL or credentials

enabled.description: Signed playback is enabled in Core

backend.description: Playback storage configured in Core; does not probe the backend

id.description: Opaque participant handle: LiveKit identity, or the LiveKit participant id (PA_…) when the identity is a phone number

identity.description: LiveKit identity (masked when the caller number would otherwise leak)

name.description: Display name; any embedded phone number is masked

masked.description: True when the LiveKit identity is a phone number and has been masked

dtmf.description: Post-answer DTMF digits (0-9, *, #, w=0.5 s pause; max 32). Never logged or audited

participantId.description: Opaque participant handle; phone-like ids are rejected

authorizationUrl.description: IdP authorization URL (state, nonce and PKCE challenge included)

expiresAt.description: Unix ms when the pending state/PKCE entry expires (10 min)

logoutUrl.description: IdP RP-initiated logout URL (client_id, post_logout_redirect_uri and state included)

expiresAt.description: Unix ms when the pending logout state expires (10 min)

fallbackUrl.description: Shared WebSocket ingress for the same LiveKit deployment

key.description: Room key (base64url, 32 bytes); never inside the JWT/audit

cancelToken.description: Private token used to withdraw this pending request

waitingMessage.description: Effective waiting-room text configured for this room.

token.description: Join token, returned once after admit

granted.description: false withdraws consent and erases this participant's stored segments

nodeAvailable.description: Availability of the bound remote STT module, when configured

model.description: Basename only; never an absolute path

code.description: Stable reason code, e.g. model_missing / ffmpeg_missing

ffmpeg.description: false = only audio/wav is accepted (webm/opus returns 501 ffmpeg_missing)

localFilesOnly.description: Weights are loaded from disk only (AGIL_STT_ALLOW_DOWNLOAD is off)

reason.description: Actionable reason when unavailable; contains no host paths

model.description: Basename only; never an absolute path

code.description: Stable reason code, e.g. translation_model_retired / model_missing

policy.description: Partial policy. roleDefaults can include just the affected roles.

expectedPolicy.description: Optional previous values for affected fields. A null userOverrides entry means the user had no override. A mismatch returns 409 access_policy_conflict.

id.description: Current leader Core id; null when no lease is held

since.description: Epoch ms when the leader acquired the lease

heartbeatAt.description: Epoch ms of the last lease renewal/heartbeat

self.description: True when this Core is the leader

held.description: This Core holds a locally valid, fenced lease
